cross_repo_sources: Agent Instructions SSM V7 (Pulse-Incarnation Engine v5, Reincarnation Protocol)

core_thesis: When asked for vulnerabilities, produce a short, high-leverage list of the sharpest risks — each concrete, system-grounded, and actionable. The system is tamper-evident, not tamper-proof. Integrity obsession without availability creates shadow systems. Every risk maps to a current mitigation status.

verbatim_quotes.speaker: Michael
verbatim_quotes.text: You don't want 500; you want the sharpest ones. Here are 12 that bite hardest.
verbatim_quotes.context: Establishing the principle of sharp risk lists over exhaustive ones

verbatim_quotes.speaker: Michael
verbatim_quotes.context: Positive reinforcement for the 12-risk list format

architecture_and_integrity.title: Single-node illusion
architecture_and_integrity.description: All ledger/Monolith logic lives in one brain per process; no replication, no cross-node consensus. A single bug or compromise can corrupt entire history and still look valid locally.
architecture_and_integrity.mitigation_detail: Dual-publish doctrine (Notion + GitHub) creates second node. GitHub serves as immutable mirror. Platform Death Test enforces hourly. No automated cross-node consensus exists; discrepancies caught by manual audit or pulse-run state-diffs.

architecture_and_integrity.title: Merkle without key rotation
architecture_and_integrity.description: Hashes give integrity, not authenticity. If attacker controls the node, they can rewrite history and recompute all hashes; nothing proves who wrote the chain.
architecture_and_integrity.mitigation_detail: GitHub commit SHAs provide some chain-of-custody (tied to PAT/account), but no cryptographic key rotation or signing in place. System relies on GitHub access controls rather than independent cryptographic proof.

architecture_and_integrity.title: In-memory default state
architecture_and_integrity.description: Quick harness keeps events only in RAM by default. Operators may think they have durability when they actually have tamper-evident scratch paper.
architecture_and_integrity.mitigation_detail: v5 Extraction Engine explicitly fights this — Platform Death Test demands every pulse run produce a GitHub commit SHA. Notion state treated as workspace, not vault.

architecture_and_integrity.title: Replay and truncation attacks
architecture_and_integrity.description: Without explicit anti-replay/anti-truncate rules, attacker can copy good prefix of ledger to new environment and present as full truth.
architecture_and_integrity.mitigation_detail: Append-first principle prevents legitimate overwrites. Reincarnation entries include session fingerprints creating verifiable chain. No formal anti-replay mechanism — relies on timestamp ordering and human review.

multi_agent_governance.title: Cascading hallucinations
multi_agent_governance.description: Agents 97/98/99 can form loop where one agent's mistake becomes canonical, then re-audited as truth because it sits in ledger.
multi_agent_governance.mitigation_detail: No-fabrication law (say UNKNOWN if data missing) and prior-worker audit create detection points. Authority Order prevents agent-generated content from outranking source material. No automated hallucination detection — depends on SOV100 as ultimate truth arbiter.

multi_agent_governance.title: Accountability fog
multi_agent_governance.description: With many agents, hard to pin responsibility when something goes wrong. Root-cause analysis across agents is non-trivial.
multi_agent_governance.mitigation_detail: Build Log DB entries include artifact_class, artifact_path, commit_sha, run_grade, platform_death_test. Handoff Ledger creates chain-of-custody. Correction entries in reincarnation map What → Root Cause → Fix Applied.

multi_agent_governance.title: Cost explosion loops
multi_agent_governance.description: Agent-to-agent orchestration can quietly explode token usage or API calls if routing rule loops, burning budget without obvious external signal.
multi_agent_governance.mitigation_detail: Single active cycle rule prevents concurrent loops. 4-phase structure with time budgets constrains per-run resource usage. No formal token budget tracking or hard circuit-breaker on API calls within a run.

product_risk_operations.title: Over-indexed on integrity, under-indexed on availability
product_risk_operations.description: System obsessed with truth and no-drift, but if verification gates are too heavy, operators bypass them for speed, rebuilding dark systems outside governance.
product_risk_operations.mitigation_detail: Michael's corrections (Don't make Michael a script monkey, Try before declining) directly address this. Mouse → Tiger is philosophical counter-weight. Tension between integrity and usability is a permanent design dial, not a solved problem.

product_risk_operations.title: No explicit risk register wired into canon
product_risk_operations.description: Informally listing risks, but no canonical, continuously-updated risk register artifact tied to missions, pillars, and agents.
product_risk_operations.mitigation_detail: THIS CHAPTER IS THE SEED. Backlog DB tracks operational items but doesn't formally categorize by risk. Recommendation: Create CANON/SYSTEM/RISK-REGISTER.md.

product_risk_operations.title: Human factors: operator fatigue and learned helplessness
product_risk_operations.description: Constant fail-closed, high scrutiny, and delete-if-imperfect can burn operators out. They may disengage or start gaming rules.
product_risk_operations.mitigation_detail: Emotional signal tracking (frustration = something is broken) in Reincarnation Protocol is detection mechanism. Evolution tracking measures whether system is getting easier to operate. Overnight autonomous pipeline mode reduces manual burden.

product_risk_operations.title: Governance lag vs. deployment speed
product_risk_operations.description: With fast-moving multi-agent architecture, formal governance can lag behind real deployments; canon becomes history book, not live control plane.
product_risk_operations.mitigation_detail: Session-bridge mechanism (REINCARNATION_SIGNAL → Handoff Ledger → Priority Stack) targets <1hr latency. Decisions beat rotation is explicit rule. Living Reincarnation State updated continuously. Gap: no broadcast mechanism, only sequential pulse-run absorption.

product_risk_operations.title: Tamper-evident ≠ tamper-proof
product_risk_operations.description: Culture might start saying 'we're unbreakable because we have a ledger'. Ledger only helps see certain classes of manipulation; doesn't stop compromise.
product_risk_operations.mitigation_detail: No speculation and map-never-outranks-layout laws prevent false confidence. War-proof doctrine focuses on recoverability rather than invulnerability. COLD-START-BOOT.md designed for assumption system WILL be compromised — question is how fast you can rebuild.

behavioral_calibration.style: sharply worded, concrete, tied to system reality, not filler
behavioral_calibration.adaptability: sharpness vs exhaustiveness is a DIAL not a rule — adapt to context
api_awareness: Budget-aware thinking: assume cost and rate limits matter
Loop paranoia: treat recursive/agent-to-agent patterns as dangerous until bounded
Backoff and failure realism: never assume infinite retries
Least-privilege orchestration: call out when a service holds more API power than needed

key_concepts.definition: The false sense of security from having all logic in one process without replication or consensus
A ledger lets you SEE manipulation; it doesn't PREVENT it. Don't conflate detection with protection.
Multi-agent loops where one agent's error becomes canonical through re-verification by other agents
When formal governance updates trail behind real deployments, canon becomes a history book not a control plane
Over-indexing on truth/no-drift creates friction that drives operators to build shadow systems outside governance
When asked for risks, produce a short high-leverage list of the sharpest ones — not a padding exercise

canon_guardrails: Risk lists should be sharp, concrete, and system-grounded — not filler
Sharpness vs exhaustiveness is a dial, not a binary rule
Every risk must map to current mitigation status
Dual-publish (Notion + GitHub) is the primary single-node-illusion mitigation
Platform Death Test enforces durability every pulse run
Authority Order prevents agent outputs from outranking source material
War-proof doctrine: focus on recoverability, not invulnerability
